data.action: 咖啡馆开店前把咖啡豆与小白花放入捧花，闻到点心香后放松微笑
data.description: 栞那穿着带围裙式腰饰的白色婚纱，站在刚开店的露台旁，把咖啡豆与小白花一起放进捧花；她闻到第一炉点心的香气便弯起眼睛，像把日常工作变成了婚礼。
data.lighting: soft morning light over the pastry window
data.mood: 把长年手艺写进花嫁日常
data.promptProse: Beside the cafe terrace, she tucks coffee beans and small white flowers into her bouquet with a relaxed smile. Morning light falls across the bridal dress and pastry window.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 星光咖啡馆的白色花嫁
data.animaCaption: She tucks coffee beans and small white flowers into her bouquet.
